Theorem
[Backward and forward asymptotic shrinkers for Type I ancient solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0182, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0183 ↗ cor:chow-iv-type-a-singular-time-reduced-distance ↗ prop:chow-iv-limit-reduced-distance-estimates ↗ lem:chow-iv-shrinker-canonical-form-characterization 1. ch30:30.31\group Type I Ancient Solutions

Let a $\kappa $-noncollapsed ancient Ricci flow satisfy $|\Rm |(x,t)\leq C/|t|$. For every basepoint and every pair of sequences $\tau _i^+\searrow 0$, $\tau _i^-\nearrow \infty $, subsequences of the rescaled flows converge to complete shrinking gradient Ricci solitons. Both limits are $\kappa $-noncollapsed and in canonical form, but either may be Euclidean.
